name: A seventh patient
prompt: Two nurses called in sick. The charge nurse asks you to take a seventh patient on top of your six.

choices.text: Say six is all you can do safely

outcome.told: She gives the patient to the float nurse and doesn't look at you for the rest of the shift.
You run the whole shift and chart through your break, but every dose goes out on time.

failure.told: A dose goes out two hours late and a fall alarm goes unanswered. The patient isn't hurt; the write-up says it was close.
